run_maml_omniglot_training: run the MAML few-shot learning training script on Omniglot dataset with configurable n-way k-shot parameters
create_functional_model_with_functorch: create a functional version of a PyTorch neural network using make_functional_with_buffers to extract parameters and buffers
compute_maml_loss_for_task: compute the MAML loss for a single task by performing inner loop gradient updates on support set
train_maml_with_vmap: train a MAML model using vmap to parallelize loss computation across multiple few-shot learning tasks
test_maml_few_shot_accuracy: test a MAML model on few-shot classification tasks by fine-tuning on support sets and evaluating on query sets
